description_en: Calls CreateEventSubscribe to create a callback for subscribing to room messages
description_zh: 调用CreateEventSubscribe创建订阅房间消息的回调
kebab_example: aliyun rtc create-event-subscribe --events ChannelEvent --app-id 9qb10000 --callback-url http://0000.com/callback --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEventSubscribe

parameters.help_en: The ID of the subscribed application
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the subscribed channel.

This parameter is required if the Users.N parameter is not empty
parameters.help_zh:
订阅的频道ID。

如果Users.N参数不为空，则此参数必填
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The callback URL. For information about the callback content, see the following callback content example
parameters.help_zh: 回调地址。回调内容请参见以下回调内容示例
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The idempotence identifier used by the client to create the subscription
parameters.help_zh: 客户端创建订阅的幂等标识
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable callback authentication. Valid values:

true: enables callback authentication.
fasle (default): disables callback authentication.

For more information, see the following callback authentication description
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启回调鉴权，取值：

true：开启。
fasle（默认值）：关闭。

详细信息请参见以下回调鉴权说明
parameters.name: need_callback_auth

parameters.help_en:
The user role. Valid values:

1: subscribes to host messages in the channel.
2: subscribes to audience messages in the channel.
Empty or other values: subscribes to messages from all roles in the channel without role filtering
parameters.help_zh:
用户角色，取值：

1：订阅频道中的主播消息。
2：订阅频道中的观众消息。
空或其他值：不进行角色过滤，订阅频道中的所有角色的消息
parameters.name: role

SubscribeId.description_en: The ID of the created subscription
